# asc_file_storage (Resource)

Manages a file storage volume in the ASC platform. File storages are CephFS-backed NFS shares that can be mounted by workloads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_file_storage" "example" {
  name = "my-file-storage"
  size = "100Gi"
}

output "file_storage_id" {
  description = "The ID of the created file storage."
  value       = asc_file_storage.example.id
}

output "file_storage_nfs_mount_path" {
  description = "The NFS mount path for the file storage."
  value       = asc_file_storage.example.nfs_mount_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the file storage. Must be unique within the platform.
- `size` (String) Size of the file storage (e.g. 100Gi).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the file storage (same as name).
- `nfs_mount_path` (String) NFS path used to mount the file storage.
- `status` (String) Current status of the file storage.
